decision: PM assignment 4c398eff and recovery policy decision 16226007. Independent TL review 71897648 for source 107370edf3548b56be0c8faa2bf4ed0a1bd3b694. CI administrator precheck d6feb84d.
purpose: Check effective permissions before account password reset and disable, including delegated recovery by system administrators and protection of system-admin targets by role.
data: Four functional cases using the existing in-memory directory and revocation fixtures. Each scenario uses two or three synthetic accounts. The positive case covers equal and strictly greater permission sets with separate fixtures.
concurrency: Serial calls in each case using the existing server test worker.
repetitions: Each new case runs once in the existing functional suite. The positive case checks the two permission relationships once each.
thresholds: Denied actions return the existing permission error without revoking sessions or recording a successful change. Authorized reset and disable succeed, including recovery via the protected role’s existing delegation rules. Equal permissions alone cannot authorize management of a system administrator. Existing last-admin, stale-claim and personal password-change assertions remain in place.
trigger: Existing functional server test discovery on PR and main.
cost: About one second for the four new case bodies in a local run, mostly the password hashing in the success cases. CI overhead is estimated at a few seconds on an existing worker.

cases: account administration checks all target permissions before changing credentials or status
only protected administrators can manage other accounts through delegated bank permissions
matching permissions without the protected role cannot reset or disable a system administrator
equal or higher permissions allow administration of a peer account
